fusions.name: Headsman's Run
fusions.desc: Runs you to a target up to 6 tiles away and chops it. Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. The chop deals 22 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Chariot Blades
fusions.desc: Blades on your axles sweep every enemy within 3 tiles. The sweep deals 14 damage, knocks each enemy back 2 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Felled Across the Road
fusions.desc: Fells a trunk 5 tiles long across the ground in front of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Outrider's Hatchet
fusions.desc: Conjures a hatchet made to be swung from the saddle: your weapon damage rises by 12%, you move 5% faster, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.
